body: Worker lesson, Sol-03d4, 2026-11-09: test-2eb53836 failed registration POST409 before any Cargo because Stage B a15b and companion retention d870 simultaneously named the same worktree. Earlier Stage A registration had exposed this too. Source src/test_run_named_root.rs:test_run_registration_named_binding_with_held matches store/common-dir/root and original namer or held owner; it deliberately does not use current focus to disambiguate multiple root names. For this workflow keep only the executing item naming the test root, and clear companion/parent names through supported termal_name_source_root with omitted path (or use genuinely separate owned worktrees). Do not assume focus change, claim renewal or an explicit launcher locator selects among simultaneous matching names. Clearing a companion does not confer test credit on it; retain attributed evidence and restore its own basis before later measured work if required. Original failure artifacts and source diagnosis: .evidence/direct-delivery-12327/runs/2eb53836/manifest.json. This is a procedural observation, not a new authority condition or permission to retry a run without its coordinator window.
